candidates.name: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The archive contains survey-specific DTM rasters at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on the survey
GeoTIFF data is distributed in 5km ZIP packages aligned to the OS Grid and referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn
The dataset reports +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy and is updated quarterly
The survey metadata index records date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model
semantic_limits: A time-stamped raster is not interchangeable with the current composite without matching survey metadata
No higher-resolution parcel value is promoted until the exact survey, tile, transformation and bytes are independently verified

candidates.name: Environment Agency retired LIDAR Composite DTM 2017 25cm record
verified_facts: The 25cm composite product is retired and no longer available on the Data Services Platform
The Environment Agency states that the composite was replaced by the 1m version
Historical 25cm data remains available through the time-stamped survey archive rather than as a current composite
semantic_limits: The retired 25cm composite must not be represented as a current primary or crosscheck service
A smaller nominal pixel size does not justify a result unless the exact current official bytes and survey lineage are available
